summary: fractal-test --keep keeps the fractal-web lane's scratch too (scripts/ci-local-web leaves it when CI_LOCAL_KEEP is set), so a web failure leaves its kit play receipts, browser traces and screenshots, and the run names where they are

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes.

compatibility.detail: Without --keep (or CI_LOCAL_KEEP) the web scratch is removed as before. CI does not run scripts/ci-local-web.

manual.detail: A kept scratch is left under ~/.cache/ci-local/web.XXXXXX; remove it when you are done.

recovery.detail: Revert the changes to scripts/st-test and scripts/ci-local-web.
